user.title: UK Vehicle Check
user.description: Enter a vehicle registration to track its tax and MOT dates from DVLA. Add the integration again for each extra vehicle.

error.invalid_registration: Enter a registration number using letters and numbers only, e.g. AB12 CDE.
error.not_found: DVLA couldn't find a vehicle with this registration.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't check this vehicle with DVLA. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle is already set up.

init.title: UK Vehicle Check
init.description: "Tax or MOT due soon" turns on when tax or MOT is due within this many days.

page_changed.title: Can't read DVLA results for {registration}
page_changed.description: The DVLA vehicle check page has changed, so UK Vehicle Check can't read the tax and MOT dates for {registration} ({error}). The last dates found are still shown. Check for an update to the integration, or report it at https://github.com/st3nic/uk_vehicle_check/issues.
